newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals' prices steady, industrial buying low.
newsitem.headline: India metals' prices steady, industrial buying low.

text.p: Indian metals' prices remained steady on Thursday while fresh industrial buying remained slow, dealers said.
Copper was quiet at 13,550 rupees per quintal, zinc at 7,850 rupees and lead at 4,150 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.

Volumes were low as major players kept away awaiting an announcement on the selling prices by state-owned producers for the second half of current month. Nickel was steady at 36,700 rupees per quintal on limited arrivals after losing 100 rupees per quintal on Wednesday.
Tin was steady at 31,100 rupees and aluminium at 7,525 rupees per quintal.
